issues.area: correctness / liveness: L5K-R14 regression (dcd2437). Bulk- and prefetch-lane adoptions are never shown to readers (R-STO-13, ARCHITECTURE §5 trailing install, RE-S40)
issues.location: Sources/ZTronAssetSync/Engine/EnginePresence.swift:239. storedLocation(of:lane:) passes .bulk and nothing re-arms the store deadline afterwards; drive returns straight after answeredFromStore at EngineDispatch.swift:745. Sources/ZTronAssetSync/Engine/EngineRuns.swift:1073: migrateLoop never re-arms after a batch's .bulk publication. The coalescing itself happens at Sources/ZTronAssetStorage/Migration/LegacyPhases.swift:568 and :636 (publishSnapshot(urgency:)). Docs that claim the opposite: docs/MIGRATION.md:192-196 and docs/adr-drafts/k.md:798-801.
issues.problem:
Since dcd2437, a job of the bulk or prefetch lane adopts at .bulk urgency. The store then only sets installDue (the window is closed) and leaves the trailing install to the engine's alarm. The commit path re-arms the alarm after every publish (refreshStoreDeadlineAfterPublish, EngineDispatch.swift:953, RE-S40); the funnel does not. So unless something else happens to arm a store deadline, nothing ever installs those adoptions. The store holds the assets, but lookup, existingLocalURL and hasAsset miss them until an unrelated install.

Proven by my own probes, each failing 5 of 5 runs at load 2.7:
- PR14a (engine, interval 0.1 s): an explicit sync during migration adopts 20 files with 0 downloads. After migration ended, I moved the clock 10 s and drove the engine to idle-silent. Readers saw 0 of 20 (once 1 of 20). The engine had no store deadline and no heap entry, while the store reported installDue=true and nextDeadline=1.1 s at now=11 s.
- PR14b (engine, the store's production windows: commit 0.25 s, install 0.1 s): a page's user-initiated resolve is visible. Its 11 neighbours, prefetched at the default lane, show 0 of 11 even 10 s later.
- PK-R14b (public API: AssetClient.prefetch and the shims, SyncTuning's default 0.1 s): 11 of 11 neighbours are stored and none downloaded, yet existingLocalURL and client.lookup answer 0 of 11 after the clock moved 10 s and 500 client round trips.

Mutant: with the funnel's urgency put back to .userInitiated, PR14a gives 20 of 20 and PK-R14b gives 11 of 11. So the regression is dcd2437's.

The compatibility harness runs with an install interval of 0, so no shim test can see this. adoptionsKeepTheInstallRate only counts installs.
issues.fix:
Re-arm the alarm after each such publication (RE-S40) in both places:

1. In storedLocation(of:lane:), after `let location = try await self.store.adoptLegacyNow(id, urgency: urgency)`, add `if urgency != .userInitiated { await self.refreshStoreDeadlineAfterPublish() }` with a `// REENTRANCY: RE-S40` comment (the lifecycle is checked inside).
2. In migrateLoop, after `progress = try await self.store.migrateLegacy(maxFiles: 64)` and its isRunning guard, add `await self.refreshStoreDeadlineAfterPublish()`, then guard isRunning again. This is needed too: PR14c shows that with only the funnel re-armed, a batch's later .bulk publication inside the last install's window stays uninstalled (0 of 6 visible, installDue since 11.1 s at now=21 s). L5K-R1 option (a) means no launch run follows migration to install it.

I checked both edits in a scratch copy: PR14a, PR14b, PR14c and PK-R14b pass, and EngineLegacyMigrationTransferTests, EngineRunPathTests and LegacyOnDemandRaceTests still pass. Both files are already authorised (L5K-R1, L5K-R14).

Tests, failing first:
- engine tests in PR14a, PR14b and PR14c's shape: with installInterval 0.1, advance past the window, drive to idle-silent, then expect harness.sink.installed to show every adopted id;
- a shim test with tuning.snapshotInstallInterval = 0.1 in PK-R14b's shape.

Also correct MIGRATION.md:192-196, k.md:798-801 and the f-11 amendment so they name the re-arm.

issues.area: battery / polling (SPEC goal 4 'no polling'; RE-S29): the migration loop busy-spins while an adopt-on-demand holds the last claimed file
issues.location: Sources/ZTronAssetStorage/Migration/LegacyPhases.swift:369-401. performMigrateLegacy pops nothing, skips the finish because claimed is not empty, and returns at once with remaining > 0 and finished == false; there is no suspension point. Sources/ZTronAssetSync/Engine/EngineRuns.swift:1069-1088: migrateLoop calls again immediately unless remaining == 0.
issues.problem:
Since L5K-R1 (9fe92fc), every job's pre-transfer read during migration takes queued prior-art files on demand (taken=true, so the file sits in claimed). When the batch empties the queue while such a call is still hashing or placing its file, each migrateLegacy call returns at once with remaining=1, and the engine calls it again. This repeats until that one adoption ends, which on a device takes as long as the hash of a large prior-art video.

Proven:
- PS3 (store): 12,095 migrateLegacy returns in 50 ms, all LegacyMigrationProgress(adopted: 12, remaining: 1, finished: false), while an adopt-on-demand's hash unit was held.
- PSPIN (engine): a job holds the last claimed file's hash for 0.301 s of wall time. A temporary counter in a scratch copy saw 83,745 migrateLegacy calls, with 0.302 s of CPU (1.00 core) at load 4.7. The unmodified code used 0.72 cores at load 187.

The root is pre-existing: the loop and the store's answer, reachable from a resolve since L3. L5K-R1 made it the normal case at the end of every sync, prefetch or ensure during migration. Cycle 2 did not change it.
issues.fix:
In performMigrateLegacy, after the pop loop and the publish, while the queue is empty and every claimed file carries an onDemand mark, `await self.awaitLegacyFlight(of: file)` for one of them, then checkLive. Give it a REENTRANCY row: the queue, the claims and the phase are re-read after the adopt-on-demand's processing ended. Then fall through to the existing finish check, so the same call finishes the migration instead of the engine polling. The wait is bounded by one adoption, and close() and shutdown already resume it through that call (row k-5). LegacyPhases.swift is authorised under L5K-R13.

Tests, failing first:
- a store test in PS3's shape: migrateLegacy, called while an adopt-on-demand holds the last file, returns only after that adoption, with finished == true;
- an engine test with a call-count seam that bounds the loop's calls while a job's hash unit is held.

Alternatively the orchestrator rules it a pre-existing WP-C/WP-F item with an owner.

issues.area: requirements / regression (R-STO-13, ARCHITECTURE §5 trailing install; K-15 shim lookups): L5K-R14's bulk-lane adoptions are never installed for readers
issues.location: Sources/ZTronAssetSync/Engine/EnginePresence.swift:184-197 (answeredFromStore: after storedLocation(of:lane:) adopts at .bulk there is no re-read of store.nextDeadline(), unlike the publish path at Sources/ZTronAssetSync/Engine/EngineDispatch.swift:953 refreshStoreDeadlineAfterPublish()); introduced by dcd2437. The claims it falsifies: docs/MIGRATION.md:192-196 and docs/adr-drafts/k.md:798-801. The test gap: Tests/ZTronAssetSyncTests/Engine/EngineLegacyMigrationTransferTests.swift:464 (adoptionsKeepTheInstallRate) and Tests/ZTronAssetStorageTests/Cleanup/LegacyOnDemandRaceTests.swift:303 (adoptionPublishesAtItsUrgency) check only the upper bound on installs and the user-initiated flush, never that coalesced adoptions are installed on their own.
issues.problem:
With L5K-R14, a bulk or prefetch job's adoptLegacyNow publishes at .bulk. Inside the install window the store marks a trailing install due: nextDeadline() = lastInstall + interval. The run re-read the deadline right after its apply, before any adoption. The funnel's path ends the job without a publication, so nothing re-reads the deadline: the engine's heap has no .store entry, and no sleeper is on the clock.

Scratch probe VerifierKC2DeadlineProbe (.build-verify-k-c2-reqs/pkg/Tests/ZTronAssetSyncTests/Engine/VerifierKC2DeadlineProbe.swift) uses the adoptionsKeepTheInstallRate setup: 100 prior-art files, interval 0.1, ManualTimeSource, migration held, sync(.force).
- HEAD: syncInstalls=1, visibleAfterSync=0, storeNextDeadline=1.1 s, engineHeapStore=nil, clockSleepers=0.
- After time.advance(by: 1) and 3 s of wall time: visible 0 of 100, extraInstalls 0.
- After migration finished (phases 3 and 4): still 0 of 100.
- 3 of 3 runs. With the cycle-1 urgency (mutant M14e: every funnel adoption at .userInitiated), 100 of 100 are visible right after the sync.

So after the coordinator's syncIfNeeded() returns .complete on a migration launch, the files whose adoption fell in the last install window stay invisible to AssetClient.lookup, CDNLocalStore.existingLocalURL and hasAsset until some later install: a user-initiated install, the next apply, or a relaunch. MIGRATION.md step 4's recommended flow therefore leaves prior-art videos unfound by BasicVideoPage. The compatibility harness runs with snapshotInstallInterval 0, so no shim test can see this.
issues.fix:
Tests first, in EngineLegacyMigrationTransferTests: a bulk sync whose jobs adopt 100 prior-art files with installInterval 0.1 under ManualTimeSource, then the clock driven past the window (EngineHarness.drive or withClock until harness.sink.installed holds them). Assert every adopted asset is in the installed snapshot and syncInstalls stays within the limiter. It fails 0 of 100 on HEAD.

Then, in answeredFromStore (an L5K-R1/R14-authorised file): set a flag when any read ran while state.migration.pending at a lane other than .userInitiated. After the loop, when the flag is set, present is non-empty and the engine runs, call `await self.refreshStoreDeadlineAfterPublish()` (RE-S40), before the existing re-validation guard. Cite it in the k-4 row and the f-11 amendment.

I validated this prototype in scratch (mutant FIX1/FIX2 in .build-verify-k-c2-reqs/mutants/apply.py): probes A and B show 100 of 100 visible after the window, with 1 coalesced trailing install, so the install bound still holds. Correct MIGRATION.md §4 and k.md's L5K-R14 'Consequence for the shims' to match.

issues.area: requirements / regression, same class: migration's own bulk batch adoptions are never installed for readers once a run has taken the parked launch run's place
issues.location: Sources/ZTronAssetSync/Engine/EngineRuns.swift:1060-1090 (migrateLoop: no store-deadline re-read after `progress = try await self.store.migrateLegacy(maxFiles: 64)` at :1073), made reachable by L5K-R1's parked-run decision (a) (startRun clears launchRunWaiting at :103, so no launch run's apply follows migration's end; 9fe92fc, cycle 1). Also docs/MIGRATION.md step 4 (:70-77) and docs/adr-drafts/k.md's parked-run paragraph (the L5K-R1 section).
issues.problem:
Migration batches publish at .bulk (LegacyPhases.swift:340). The engine never re-reads nextDeadline() after a migrateLegacy call. Before L5K-R1, the launch run started when migration ended, and its apply installed at once, which flushed those publications. With decision (a), any run started during migration takes the launch run's place; that is exactly MIGRATION.md step 4's launch-task sync. Once that run has finished, nothing flushes migration's later coalesced installs.

Scratch probes, 60 bulk-policy plus 40 on-demand prior-art files, interval 0.1, sync during held migration, then migration finishes:
- Probe I on HEAD: all 100 stored, visiblePages 0 of 40 (and visibleBulk 0 of 60, from the previous issue), storeNextDeadline 1.1 s, engine heap nil. After advance(by: 1) and 3 s: 0 of 40. 3 of 3 runs.
- Probe I under M14e (cycle-1 urgency): bulk 60 of 60 but pages 0 of 40.
- Probe J, with the sync's trailing install run first and the previous issue's fix (FIX1): pages 0 of 40 (storeNextDeadline 1.6 s, heap nil).
- FIX1 plus the pre-L5K-R1 parked run: 40 of 40, because the launch run's apply flushes.
- FIX1 plus a migrateLoop re-read (FIX2): 40 of 40.

On-demand prior-art assets, and any file migration adopts after the launch-task sync ended, stay out of the readers' snapshot for the session.
issues.fix:
Tests first: the probe I/J shape as an engine test. On-demand prior-art files adopted by migration after a sync took the launch run's place reach harness.sink.installed once the clock passes the install window. It fails 0 of 40 on HEAD.

Then, in migrateLoop (EngineRuns.swift, authorised under L5K-R1), after the `guard self.isRunning` that follows each migrateLegacy call: `await self.refreshStoreDeadlineAfterPublish()` and re-check isRunning, with a REENTRANCY comment (RE-S29 or RE-S40: the lifecycle; the heap's store entry is replaced).

Validated in scratch as FIX2: all 4 probes pass. ZTronAssetSyncTests 336/336 (332 plus the 4 probes), ZTronAssetStorageTests 453/453, ZTronAssetKitTests 85/85, ZTronAssetCompatibilityTests 72/72 (70 plus 2 probes). Record it in k.md under the authorised edits and the parked-run decision.

issues.problem: The premise that the race was reached depends on scheduling: it needs at least one 'the same legacy file' debug line across 20 launches with inline executors. It never failed in my runs: --quick, the simulator, TSan x3 at load 4-12, and my own probes, which saw 509 and 855 joins over 20 and 30 launches. But the L5K-R2 table does not list it, and a host that never interleaves would fail the test on a premise rather than on R-STO-11.
issues.fix: Record it in the L5K-R2 table as a scheduling premise (pattern (a)) with the measured margin, or make the premise deterministic, for example with a held-migration variant that provably reaches the join. Keep the per-launch zero-transfer assertions.

issues.area: concurrency edge of the L5K-R14 lane choice (unproven)
issues.location: Sources/ZTronAssetSync/Engine/EnginePresence.swift:189 (the lane is read before the adoptLegacyNow await) and :239
issues.problem: A bulk job promoted to the user-initiated lane while its adoption is in flight (an ensureAvailable or resolve joins the job meanwhile) publishes at .bulk. Its user-initiated asker can then return before the readers' snapshot holds the asset. Without the first fix, nothing bounds the delay; with it, the delay is at most snapshotInstallInterval. I did not probe it.
issues.fix: After the first fix, either accept a delay of at most one install interval and say so in k.md's L5K-R14 section, or re-read `self.state.jobs[transfer]?.lane` after the await and, when it became .userInitiated, ask the store once more at .userInitiated: the joined or present path then installs at once.

issues.location: docs/adr-drafts/k.md:7 ('No contract signature changed.') and docs/adr-drafts/k.md:30 ('**Contract change requests:** no signature change.')

issues.area: tests / coverage notes for the docs level (not a gate)
issues.location: Sources/ZTronAssetStorage/Migration/LegacyPhases.swift:283-284 and :653-654 (the `else { continuation.resume() }` branches of awaitLegacyAdoption and awaitLegacyFlight), :294 and :662 (the no-mark guards of endLegacyAdoption and endLegacyOnDemand)
issues.problem: The merged export shows these new L5K-R13 lines uncovered. LegacyPhases.swift is at 97.02 % (652/672), and the Storage gate passes at 97.41 %. - L5K-C1-00: PS1b-c2 and PS2, the true PK2b interleaving where both calls hash and the batch's rename makes the on-demand read fail with notFound, both pass. PK2b and PK8u, through the engine over a migration that runs at its own pace, gave 0 downloads in 50 launches each, with 509 and 855 joins.

FAIL: 2 blocking, 2 non-blocking. This is the cycle-2 requirements-lens close-out of WP-K on wp/k at 1901e91. I did not write this code (P4).

- A public-API probe of my own (the PK2b and PK8u shapes) downloads in 12–17 of 20 launches under M13. HEAD downloads nothing in 2×20 and 1×100 launches.

Every test-strength item now fails against its mutant:

- M3 for L5K-C1-05;
- M1, CCR-K1, with 146–150 files downloaded through the shims.

For L5K-C1-01 and L5K-C1-03, the old tests fail 6 of 6 with a 200 ms stall before the sync. HEAD's tests pass 10 of 10 at 200 ms and at 500 ms.

(2) Ownership is clean. The diff touches only WP-K's §1.2 files, docs/MIGRATION.md (L5K-R10) and the files L5K-R1, R13 and R14 authorise. The one package signature change, `adoptLegacyNow(_:urgency:)`, is ruled by L5K-R14. No protected file changed, and the harness-frozen tag is present.

- The sync's own adoptions at .bulk (cycle 2, L5K-R14).
- Migration's own later batch adoptions once a run has taken the launch run's place (cycle 1's parked-run decision (a)).

Both are deterministic in scratch probes. A prototype fix in the two authorised engine files passes every probe, Sync 336, Storage 453, Kit 85 and Compatibility 72.

(4) L5K-R13 to R15 are applied and recorded, with two exceptions:
- MIGRATION §4 and k.md say adopted files reach the lookups within snapshotInstallInterval. That is false while the defect above stands.
- The k.md header still says no contract signature changed.
